en: Sepia-toned aerial view over a historic European town with dense tiled roofs. A large Gothic-style church with pointed windows and a steep roof dominates the left foreground. In the middle distance is a small market square surrounded by multi-storey buildings. Trees and a flat horizon line with industrial chimneys are visible in the background. Printed German captions appear at the top.
